title: Administrator - Export Team
salary_text: £13 per hour (Onsite Canteen, onsite convenience store, 26 day)
description:
We're looking for an Export Coordinator / Administrator to join a busy team, supporting the worldwide export of spares and repairs. You'll play an important role in ensuring shipments are processed accurately, on time and in line with customer requirements and export regulations. Based in Yeovil, this is a temporary role and the team currently work hybrid, 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (training will be full time in the office).
What you'll be doing:
- Coordinating worldwide exports of spares and repairs to customers and suppliers.
- Preparing export documentation to meet HM Revenue & Customs and Department for Business & Trade requirements, as well as customer-specific requirements.
- Producing shipping documents that comply with contractual and country-specific regulations.
- Ensuring documentation meets Letter of Credit requirements where applicable.
- Completing export entries using the GTS system where required.
- Monitoring customer orders to ensure goods are despatched on time and in line with agreed service levels.
- Acting as a point of contact for internal departments, responding to queries efficiently.
- Keeping stakeholders updated on shipment progress and delivery arrangements.
- Ensuring export procedures, including export licences and commodity codes, are followed correctly.
- Liaising with packing contractors to ensure goods are prepared for shipment within agreed timescales.
- Booking air, sea and road freight with freight forwarders and customer-appointed agents.
- Checking freight invoices against agreed rates before processing for payment.
- Maintaining accurate export records and departmental documentation.
- Ensuring shipping documentation is issued and distributed in line with company procedures.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.
- Supporting colleagues within the Export team and providing cover during periods of absence or increased workload.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in an Export Coordinator, Shipping Administrator, Logistics Administrator or similar administration role.
- Experience within a shipping or distribution environment would be beneficial.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and SAP (SAP is desirable)
- A proactive approach with a focus on delivering excellent customer service.

description:

What's on Offer:
- Opportunity to join a stable and growing business
- Supportive team environment with a strong focus on collaboration
- Varied role with scope to develop your skills
- Competitive salary and benefits package including 25 days plus BH and free parking

We are currently supporting a well-established and growing manufacturer to recruit a Customer Service Administrator. This is an exciting opportunity to join a customer focused organisation where service quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything they do.

The Role

As Customer Service Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering a high-quality warranty service, ensuring customers receive a seamless and efficient experience. Acting as a central point of contact, you will manage warranty claims, coordinate service activity, and support internal teams in maintaining strong customer relationships.

This is a varied and fast-paced role, ideal for someone who thrives in a busy environment and enjoys problem-solving, organisation, and customer interaction.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to warranty claims via phone and email in a timely and professional manner
- Log all communications and maintain accurate records using the CRM system
- Coordinate the dispatch of replacement parts and raise associated orders
- Arrange collections of faulty components in line with company procedures
- Authorise and organise service callouts in accordance with warranty terms
- Process invoices and manage documentation related to service visits
- Analyse service reports to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement
- Build and maintain effective relationships with external service partners

About You

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual with excellent communication skills and a strong customer service mindset.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
- Proven ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- Strong administrative and organisational skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Solid communication skills, both written and verbal

title: Administrator for School Nursing
description: We are looking for an Administrator to join our School Nursing Service! Through delivery of the Healthy Child Programme, our School Nursing Service work in partnership with children, families and professionals to promote health and wellbeing by supporting children, young people and their carers with their physical, mental and emotional health and wellbeing, and by equipping young people with the resources they need to make healthy lifestyle choices throughout life. The School Nursing Service supports all school aged (5-19) children and young people across Bristol, working in partnership with multi-disciplinary health teams within community and acute services, local authority and voluntary sector teams - to deliver a clinically effective, high quality health service to the school aged population, in a variety of settings. The working hours are 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday. To provide comprehensive administrative support to the School Nursing team. To act as an effective link across CCHP staff, Schools, Children's Social Care, GPs, the general public and other relevant bodies. The post requires organisation, attention to detail and initiative to ensure that the best possible care is delivered to children, young people, their families and that targeted tasks are completed on time. The post holder will be based in North Somerset at Badger House, and will work closely with administrators in other areas such as Health Visiting, Children's Continence and the Children Looked After and Care Leavers Teams. The Post Holder will be responsible for: Liaising with families, other health professionals and other agencies to make appointments on behalf of and at the request of the school nursing team. Acting as the central information and contact point for parents/ carers, medical and nursing staff and other agencies and disseminating information as appropriate to the school nursing team. Data entry of information into pre-populated templates and work based systems. Undertaking any necessary photocopying, filing, and other administrative duties to ensure the effective running of the office. Arranging, organising and co-ordinating the booking of premises for meetings. Working flexibly to support other school nursing team administrators across the area. Please see the attached Job Description for a full list of duties and responsibilities before applying for this position. We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role and can only accept applications from UK based applicants.

title: Medical Receptionist/Administrator
description: Hours 18 -32 hours per week (part-time, job share considered) We are looking for a friendly, proactive, and organised Receptionist/Administrator to join our team. We are offering between 18 and 32 hours per week, and a job share will be considered. As one of the first points of contact for our patients, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring they receive a professional, friendly, and efficient service. You will work across both reception and administrative functions, using your excellent communication and organisational skills to help deliver high-quality patient care. To provide reception and administrative support for the practice, dealing with patients, clinical staff, and colleagues in an efficient, professional, and courteous manner. You will receive, assist, and direct patients to the appropriate service or healthcare professional and undertake a variety of administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. Working in accordance with agreed procedures, protocols, and timescales, your responsibilities will include maintaining accurate patient records, document management, workflow administration, and handling clinical correspondence. You will require excellent communication and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise your workload while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. You will work closely alongside clinicians and colleagues, always maintaining patient confidentiality and providing a high standard of customer service. Job summary As a Receptionist/Administrator you will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. The role includes a variety of reception, administration and prescription support duties. About us We are a friendly dispensing practice with a patient list of just over 4,200. Our team consists of three GP Partners, two Salaried GPs, a Paramedic, two Practice Nurses, one Healthcare Assistant (HCA), five Dispensers, an administration and reception team of eight staff, and a Practice Manager. We are seeking a motivated, well-organised individual to join our team. For this role, it is essential that you are reliable, flexible, have excellent communication and IT skills, and enjoy working as part of a team. You should have a good standard of general education, including at least three GCSEs at Grade 4 (formerly Grade C) or above, including English and Maths. Previous experience in a healthcare environment would be an advantage but is not essential, as full training will be provided. For further information or to arrange an informal visit to the practice, please contact the Practice Manager on 01823 490505 or email reception.northcurryhc@nhs.net . Please refer to the attached job description for comprehensive information regarding the responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations associated with the position.
